Verses.13: "Enter through the narrow gate! For the gate is wide and the way broad that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
Verses.14: The gate is narrow, and the way constricted that leads to life, and there are few who find it."
Verses.15: "Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
Verses.16: You will recognize them my their fruits. Are grapes gathered from among thorns or figs from thistles?
Verses.17: Every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
Verses.18: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.
Verses.19: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
Verses.20: Thus, you will recognize them by their fruits."
Verses.21: "Not everyone who says to Me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the Kingdom of Heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.
Verses.22: Many will say to Me on that day, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name? In Your name cast out demons? In Your name perform many miracles?
Verses.23: Then I will declare to them, 'I never knew you. Leave me, you evildoers!'"
Verses.24: "Therefore, everyone who hears these words of Mine and puts them into practice will be like a wise person. They are like the wise person who built their house upon the rock.
Verses.25: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds howled and slammed against that house. Yet, it did not collapse because its foundation was on the rock.
Verses.26: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not put them into practice is like a fool. They are like a fool who built their house on sand.
Verses.27: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds howled and slammed against that house, and it fell. It collapsed with a great crash."
Verses.28: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching.
Verses.29: He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
